title: Air Intake System Cleaning "S" Tool
lead: Due to a request from service technicians, MOC has reintroduced the Air Intake System Cleaning "S" Tool (Part No. 74100). This tool was previously replaced by a newly designed "S" Tool (Part No. 75450). MOC customers will now have a choice of two different "S" Tools. Both items are currently in stock.
body: MOC# 74100 MOC# 75450 The "S" Tool (Part No. 75450) design has been improved by securing the tip with Loctite® to prevent it from coming loose during a service.
